content.title: Merge Intervals
content.description: Given an array of intervals where intervals[i] = [starti, endi], merge all overlapping intervals and return an array of the non-overlapping intervals.

examples.explanation: Since intervals [1,3] and [2,6] overlap, merge them into [1,6].

hints: I'll sort the intervals by start time and then merge them one by one
Perfect! Sorting first is key. Can you describe how you check if two intervals overlap?
Think about when the start of the current interval is less than or equal to the end of the previous interval
follow_up_questions: What if intervals could have negative coordinates?
How would you handle inserting a new interval into an already merged list?
What if you needed to find the maximum number of overlapping intervals at any point?
